name: Society C | Lemon Cherry Z
description: Society C's Lemon Cherry Z is an Indica Hybrid strain made by crossing Lemon Cherry Gelato with Zkittlez. It boasts a blend of terpenes including Linalool, Caryophyllene, and Limonene, which contribute to its aromas of citrus, gas, and floral notes. This strain is recognized for its uplifting, relaxing, and creative effects.
